scheme: New Zealand Business Industry Classification (BIC), built on ANZSIC 2006
edition: BIC Code List 2022 (valid from 1 April 2022 to 1 April 2023, status Released)
note: The BIC code begins with the division letter and the ANZSIC class (for example A011110: division A, class 0111). The upper levels are the ANZSIC 2006 structure. The IRD has updated some codes since (for example vapes, April 2025); a later list was not obtained.
sources: NZBN API portal: Business Industry Classification (BIC) codes 2022.zip, https://portal.api.business.govt.nz/api/nzbn
ABS: ANZSIC 2006 structure (the levels above the BIC code)
